capabilities: Save TikTok URLs as notes with embedded video players and fetched metadata
Transcribe video audio locally using Whisper via Python, yt-dlp, and ffmpeg
Review, tag, and filter saved videos in a sidebar queue
Customize file naming, note titles, and content with template variables
Process multiple URLs in batches from the clipboard
extras: Transcription is desktop-only and opt-in, installing external packages via a one-click script; the plugin is still under review for the Community Plugins directory, so it currently installs via BRAT or manually.
motivation: The author built it as a personal project to fit their workflow around saving and reviewing TikTok content in Obsidian, then decided to share it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture TikTok videos as notes with embedded players, fetched metadata, and transcribed audio.

relations.evidence: Dataview integration: Insert dataview queries based on active filters

summary: Saves TikTok videos as Markdown notes with embedded playback, metadata extraction, and optional local Whisper transcription.
